question: Una cohort de perfils públics seleccionada només amb dades anteriors al 2026-08-13 conserva expectativa positiva en senyals futurs després del retard observable, costos Ostium i límits d'un compte de 500 USDC?
source: Ostium public on-chain fills through the official read-only SDK

selection.identifiers_versioned: sha256 only in the case-study audit; plain public addresses remain temporary outside Git

signal_scope.scope_amendment: Expanded by explicit user instruction on 2026-08-13 after six BTC/USD events had already been observed; those events remain valid forward observations, not retrospective selections.
signal_scope.execution_boundary: each asset and venue requires its own contract, latency, liquidity, cost and sizing gate before paper simulation or promotion
signal_scope.copy_entry: first observation after a public Open fill
signal_scope.copy_exit: first observation after the matching public full close, StopLoss, TakeProfit, CloseDayTrade or Liquidation
signal_scope.partial_and_remove_collateral: record but do not simulate until semantics are reconciled

shadow_paper_execution.entry_and_exit: first observable bid/ask captured by the monitor after each public fill
shadow_paper_execution.cross_day_policy: do not claim net PnL until rollover units and boundary are reconciled
shadow_paper_execution.missing_quote_policy: skip rather than substitute the trader execution price

validation_routes.exceptional_single_wallet: at least 30 copied net closes, profit factor >= 1.5, positive first and second half, drawdown <= 15%, no liquidation and largest win <= 35% of gross profit

automatic_reject: public detection latency makes entry non-replicable
one wallet or asset supplies more than half of profit
net expectancy is non-positive after costs
no qualifying market sample by the maximum extension date
